title: Decentralized Card Catalog
definition: A decentralized system for organizing and discovering data similar to a library catalog.

difficulty_levels.beginner: A system that functions like a library catalog, but for data, allowing users to publish lightweight records pointing to their data, making it discoverable in a decentralized manner.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A decentralized system for organizing and discovering data, analogous to a library catalog, where users publish lightweight records linking to their datasets with optional tags.
difficulty_levels.expert: A decentralized system that emulates a library catalog for data, where users publish lightweight records that link to their datasets with optional tags, primarily dominated by geospatial/satellite imagery publishers but open to non-geo contributions.

extra_fields.insight: Organizing and discovering data in a decentralized manner, emulating a library catalog for data.
